    {
      "name": "tests",

      "evidence": "Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree assertion and test framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}.",

      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Overhauls unit testing infrastructure to eliminate Boost.Test and introduce expression decomposition for failure diagnostics.
